outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustrating the experimental design (syngeneic tumor injection workflow), not a data plot.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression showing mean with individual data points (gray, blue, and red dots) overlaid for each group.
Tumor volume plot displays individual data points for each mouse (black, blue, red dots) with mean and 95% CI overlaid.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression showing mean with individual data points overlaid for each group.
This is a line plot showing tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlaying them would make the plot unreadable.
Panel F includes fluorescent micrographs and an accompanying bar chart quantifying CD4 intensity, which shows individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars.
Panel G includes fluorescent micrographs and an accompanying bar chart quantifying pERK intensity, which shows individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars.
